definition: Longing — awakened by the thundering cloud. In Ghatakarpara v.19, clouds thundering make travelers long; the longing is the vyabhicāri (transitory state) that the sthāyibhāva (love) transforms.

sources.claim: utkaṇṭhayanti pathikān jaladāḥ svanantaḥ (clouds thundering make travelers long)
